name: hovercard1

frames.best_why: The round button is stretched open showing 'Visit' beside the arrow, the card's key hover moment.

tagline: Red abstract photo card whose round arrow button widens to say Visit.
summary: A wide image card of a glossy red 3D object with a black name pill at the lower left and a round arrow button at the lower right that stretches into a Visit label on hover.
appearance: A wide card filled by a crimson-lit photo of a glossy red abstract form, rounded at the corners. A black pill reading 'Distrokings' sits at lower left and a dark circular arrow button at lower right, both floating over the image.
behaviour: Hovering the round button stretches it sideways to reveal the word Visit beside the arrow, while the photo itself eases from a slight zoom back to full size. Moving away collapses the button to its arrow.
demo_content: Photo of a glossy red abstract sculpture, name pill 'Distrokings'.
search_phrases: image card with expanding visit button
red photo card with name tag
card whose button grows on hover
portfolio image tile with pill label
rounded photo card with read more
use_when: A portfolio or showcase grid needs image cards with a compact link that stays tidy at rest.
avoid_when: On touch screens the Visit label never expands, so the button reads only as a bare arrow.
customise: The image URL, the 'Distrokings' label and the button text are hardcoded; the black palette and rounded shapes need editing in the file. No props.
weight_why: One image and CSS width and scale transitions; nothing runs until hover.

a11y.note: The Visit label appears only on hover and the button has no accessible name at rest; the photo's alt text is just 'image'.

issues: The image alt text is only 'image'.
The Visit label is hover-only and the button lacks an accessible name.
polish_why: Bold red image and tidy label; the button is a bare arrow until hover and alt text is generic.
